fact: The 2022 Ministry budget states the Ministry, with GIZ, rolled out the dLRev software in 114 Metropolitan, Municipal and District Assemblies (of 260 MMDAs), added e-billing and e-payment modules, and in 2022 will build on dLRev to improve revenue administration in all MMDAs.
title: 2022 Programme Based Budget Estimates: Ministry of Local Government, Decentralisation and Rural Development
